blocks.text: Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, warned Thursday of “new counter means” along the inter-Korean border, adding propaganda loudspeaker broadcasts against South Korea will be ready within days. Kim’s warning came a day after she visited key locations along the southern border and threatened to take military action against what the North called South Korean troops’ provocations against its border fortification work. “Our new counter means will get into the alert for duty at all the southern border line and the loudspeakers against the ROK will be on standby in a matter of days,” Kim said […]...
